text: {"lessons":["Since past price changes do not predict future changes, I should base decisions on current risk and diversification rather than recent performance.","My reluctance to admit a mistake and the pain of selling at a loss can keep me from making sound decisions; I should assess each holding objectively.","I have made no trades so far, and the account has risen overall despite a decline in one period; I should avoid trading just to react to short-term fluctuations."]}
